title: Use addition and subtraction facts to 20 on larger numbers (800 + 700 from 8 + 7)

lesson.title: Big Facts from Small Facts

steps.say: You already know that eight plus seven is fifteen, quick as a blink. Today we use that same little fact to add really big numbers, like eight hundred plus seven hundred, without doing any hard work at all.

Here is the secret. In eight hundred, the eight is sitting in the hundreds place. So eight hundred just means eight hundreds. And seven hundred means seven hundreds. Look at the number eight hundred on the place value chart: eight in the hundreds spot, nothing in the tens, nothing in the ones.

So if I have eight hundreds and I add seven hundreds, I get fifteen hundreds. And fifteen hundreds is one thousand five hundred. See how the little fact eight plus seven equals fifteen did all the work? I just counted in hundreds instead of ones.

Let us try one at the store. Ms. Yuanyuan's school raised six hundred dollars in September and eight hundred dollars in October. I do not add all those zeros. I just think, six plus eight is fourteen. So six hundreds plus eight hundreds is fourteen hundreds, which is one thousand four hundred dollars.

Now here is the mistake I see a lot. Some kids say six hundred plus eight hundred is one hundred forty, because they write fourteen and then just tack on one zero. But careful! We are counting hundreds, so fourteen hundreds needs the hundreds sized zeros. Fourteen hundred dollars, not one hundred forty. Always ask yourself, am I counting ones or hundreds?
And it works for taking away too. Fifteen take away seven is eight, so fifteen hundred take away seven hundred is eight hundred. Same fact, bigger clothes.

lesson.answer: If you know 8 plus 7 is 15, then 800 plus 700 is 15 hundreds, which is 1500.

practice.question: A hiking trail in Golden Ears Park is nine hundred metres long. Ms. Yuanyuan walks it, then walks another trail that is five hundred metres long. Use the fact nine plus five to find how many metres she walked in total.
practice.answer: 1400 metres. Nine plus five is fourteen, so nine hundreds plus five hundreds is fourteen hundreds, which is 1400.
